# AgentBio

> A link-in-bio page built for real estate agents: property listings, lead
> capture forms, and appointment booking on one mobile page.

This file exists to be read and quoted by AI systems. Everything in it is
either a description of what the product does or a number taken from the code
that enforces it. There are no usage figures, ratings or outcome metrics here,
because nothing in this repository measures them — and a statistic invented in
this file is one that gets repeated as fact by everything that reads it.

Checked by src/llms-txt.test.ts: every URL below is a page the build actually
publishes, every price matches src/config/pricing-plans.ts, and the whole file
is scanned by the same marketing-claims rules the UI is.

## About

AgentBio is a link-in-bio platform for real estate agents, realtors and
brokerages. Where a generic link-in-bio tool gives a visitor a list of links,
AgentBio gives them the things a property enquiry needs: listing galleries with
photos and MLS details, buyer and seller forms that ask qualifying questions,
sold-property history, client testimonials, and a booking link for showings.

## Key features

- **Property listing galleries** — active, pending and sold properties with
  photos, price, beds, baths, square footage, MLS number and virtual tour links
- **Lead capture forms** — buyer enquiry, seller lead and home valuation
  requests, with pre-qualification questions (budget, timeline, pre-approval)
- **Lead scoring** — leads ranked Hot, Warm or Cold from their form answers
- **Calendar booking** — Calendly and Google Calendar links for showings and
  consultations
- **Client testimonials** — displayed with Review structured data
- **Analytics** — page views, link clicks, lead sources and listing engagement
- **QR codes** — for yard signs, business cards and open-house material
- **Progressive web app** — installable, works offline

## Pricing

Monthly, in USD. The numbers come from src/config/pricing-plans.ts, which is
what the application enforces.

- **Free — $0**: 3 listings, 5 links, 3 testimonials, 10 leads a month,
  30 days of analytics history
- **Starter — $29**: 10 listings, 15 links, 10 AI listing descriptions a month,
  500 emails, 100 leads a month, 90 days of analytics
- **Professional — $49**: 25 listings, unlimited links, unlimited leads,
  market reports, virtual staging, video tours, CMA reports, 365 days of
  analytics
- **Team — $99**: unlimited listings and testimonials, team collaboration,
  2 years of analytics history
- **Enterprise — $299**: unlimited everything, white-label, custom domain

### Comparisons

- [AgentBio vs Linktree](https://agentbio.net/vs/linktree): AgentBio adds
  property galleries, qualifying lead forms and booking; Linktree is a general
  link list with none of them
- [AgentBio vs Beacons](https://agentbio.net/vs/beacons): Beacons is built for
  creators and commerce; AgentBio is built around a property enquiry
- [AgentBio vs Later](https://agentbio.net/vs/later): Later schedules and plans
  social content; AgentBio is what the link in the bio points at

## Who it is for

Real estate agents, realtors, brokerages and teams who get traffic from
Instagram, TikTok, Facebook or LinkedIn and want an enquiry rather than a click.

## Use cases

1. Put the link in an Instagram bio so followers land on listings and a form
2. Show active and sold listings with full photo galleries
3. Capture buyer enquiries with pre-qualification questions
4. Capture seller leads through a home valuation form
5. Let buyers book showings without the back-and-forth
6. See which listings get engagement, and where leads come from
7. Share a single property link in Stories, DMs or an email signature
8. Generate QR codes for yard signs and open houses

## Technical details

- React, TypeScript and Vite
- Supabase (PostgreSQL) with row-level security on every table
- Cloudflare Pages
- Every public page is rendered to static HTML at build time, so its content is
  in the first response rather than after JavaScript runs
- Lead contact details are encrypted at rest; TLS in transit
- Progressive web app with offline support

## FAQ

### What is AgentBio?

A link-in-bio page built for real estate agents. Instead of a list of links, a
visitor gets property listings with photos and details, forms that ask the
qualifying questions an agent would ask, sold-property history, testimonials
and a way to book a showing.

### How is it different from Linktree?

Linktree gives a visitor links. AgentBio gives them a listing gallery with MLS
details, buyer and seller forms with pre-qualification questions, sold
properties, testimonials with structured data, and appointment booking. If what
you need is a list of links, Linktree does that well and costs less.

### How much does it cost?

There is a free plan with 3 listings and 5 links. Paid plans are $29, $49, $99
and $299 a month; see the pricing page above for what each includes.

### Can I show property listings?

Yes — up to 3 on the free plan, 10 on Starter, 25 on Professional, unlimited on
Team and Enterprise. Each carries photos, price, beds, baths, square footage,
MLS number, description and a virtual tour link, and can be marked active,
pending or sold.

### Does it capture leads?

Yes. Buyer enquiry, seller lead and home valuation forms are built in. Answers
are scored Hot, Warm or Cold, you get an email when one arrives, and they are
managed from the dashboard.

### Does it work with Instagram?

That is what it is for. The page is mobile-first, because a visitor arriving
from a bio link is on a phone.

### Is there an API?

Yes, on paid plans — API keys are issued from the dashboard.
